Tooltip

Tooltips deliver short, contextual labels on hover or focus. They are non-interactive, purely informational overlays.

Basic Tooltip

Add data-zak-tooltip="text" to any element. The tooltip appears on hover and focus, and hides on mouse-out and Escape.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" data-zak-tooltip="Saves your changelog">Save</button>

<input type="text" class="zak-input" data-zak-tooltip="Enter at least 8 characters">

Tooltip Placements

Use data-zak-tooltip-placement with top, bottom, left or right (default top). The tooltip auto-flips when it would clip the viewport.

Tooltip with Arrow

The arrow points at the trigger. It comes from the popover utility layer, and can be disabled by removing the generated .zak-tooltip-arrow element.

Notifications
HTML
<span class="zak-badge zak-badge-info"
      data-zak-tooltip="3 new mentions"
      data-zak-tooltip-placement="bottom">Notifications</span>

Rich Tooltip

Keep to one or two lines of plain text. If you need more content, reach for a Popover instead.

For interactive content such as links, buttons or forms use a popover to satisfy keyboard and screen-reader expectations.

Disable Pointer Events

Tooltips never capture pointer events (pointer-events: none). Hovering the label itself won’t keep it open, and it never blocks clicks under it.

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
/* Class Summary */
.zak-tooltip           /* Floating label (hidden until active) */
.zak-tooltip-active    /* Added by JS to show */
.zak-tooltip-arrow     /* JS-generated directional arrow */

/* Variables used */
--zak-tooltip-bg       /* Default dark background */
--zak-tooltip-text     /* Label text color */
--zak-z-tooltip        /* Highest overlay z-index */
--zak-shadow-md        /* Soft floating shadow */

JavaScript

HTML
// Data attributes (automatic)
//   data-zak-tooltip="text"         content to display
//   data-zak-tooltip-placement      "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right"

// Programmatic API
zak.tooltip.show(el, { text: 'Copied!', placement: 'top' });
zak.tooltip.hide(el);

// Show while copying values
button.addEventListener('click', function () {
    zak.tooltip.show(button, { text: 'Copied to clipboard' });
    setTimeout(function () { zak.tooltip.hide(button); }, 1500);
});

Accessibility

  • Tooltips are informational only — never put critical instructions or required actions inside one.
  • The framework wires aria-describedby to the tooltip element so screen readers announce it.
  • Tooltips trigger on focus as well as hover, satisfying keyboard users.
  • Keep the text under ~120 characters; long tooltips become annoying.
  • Use role="tooltip" semantics (already applied) — never add focusable content inside.
